Sources and notes
Streams: Luminate (Activity Over Time, worldwide, all tracks and per master; per-song territory and US market splits from each song page). Territories: Luminate Activity by Location, plus daily Activity Over Time for the US, Australia, Canada, UK, New Zealand and Sweden, US market (DMA) totals and daily streams for the top 10 US markets plus Seattle, Los Angeles and New York. Releases: Wade Forster Master Release Dates. Playlists & social: Chartmetric exports. Streams by playlist: DSP playlist analytics export (1 Jan 2025 – 5 Oct 2026), plus Community Music playlist analytics for 6–12 Oct 2026. YouTube: YouTube Studio content export (top 500 videos). Apple Music lifetime song stats and daily plays per song: Apple Music for Artists (lifetime to date, pulled 14 Oct 2026; daily plays to 12 Oct). Spotify audience and per-song figures: Spotify for Artists (audience timeline to 12 Oct 2026, per-song stats as at 12 Oct 2026). AAA campaign metrics, chart positions and milestones: AAA release tracking sheet. Shows and announcements: Wade Forster Master Timeline, with AU tour support acts from The Note. Capacities and tickets sold: global ticket sales tracker (7 Oct 2026). Daily streams by DSP (14 Aug – 12 Oct 2026): Spotify for Artists per-song timelines, Apple Music for Artists, and Community Music for YouTube (incl. Content ID), Amazon Music, Pandora, Deezer and SoundCloud; Community Music playlist streams for the same days. YouTube one-sheet: YouTube Studio artist analytics, total reach, 15 Jul – 12 Oct 2026.
